purpose: Guide original Lucas voice generation toward the measured vocal character and conversational dynamics without reproducing a biometric voiceprint.

measured_reference.segment_scope: isolated Lucas-only speech segment from the user-provided 18.47 s reference clip
measured_reference.interpretation: naturally low but not forced; continuous connected speech with strong human pitch and energy variation

target_character.register: naturally low young-adult male, never artificially pushed downward
target_character.delivery: relaxed private conversation, connected thought groups, continuous phrases, never syllabic or choppy
target_character.energy: restrained, warm, spontaneous, dynamically alive rather than flat
target_character.prosody: clear natural pitch movement, almost no dead air inside short phrases, soft falling phrase endings and small irregular timing changes
target_character.breathing: subtle natural breaths between thought groups only, never inserted theatrically
target_character.performance_source_rule: For approval candidates, prefer a naturally performed speech source. Do not use a visibly robotic TTS performance as the timing/prosody donor.
avoid: long dead pauses inside short conversational phrases
